BL-1282 — DEFECT — the bounce recorders accept any non-blank string as --commit: 42 of 346 stored bounces breach the 10-hex contract and 19 cite a commit that resolves to nothing
What it solves: The two invariant-unencoded bounces in the same shift (BL-1245, BL-1194,
both raised by the architect) were checked and are correctly attributed —
both tickets do declare invariants in their YAML, so BL-633's mechanism
worked as designed and no spec-side defect is implied by them.
Approval context: Approve if bounce telemetry is worth defending at write time. The one judgement call is the DISPOSITION of a bad commit: this ticket asks for a parse-time refusal (the caller has the real hash in hand and can re-run in seconds), rather than writing the row with an "unwalkable" marker.
